evidence: Most plural/whole-collection asks are graded over the whole collection: 'everywhere a message appears' (thread, reply quote, search snippet, earlier versions, transcript) is covered by safe_formatting legs 2-3 plus edits_and_stale_edit leg 1; 'order ... wherever you see them: the thread, search and the transcript' by sent_once_in_order Part B (two users, reloads, search, transcript); 'must appear only once' by Part A (thread, search, transcript); 'deletes whatever is now too old' by timer_changes leg 1, which names both M-13 messages older than 7 days in seed (K-18 edited to JUDGE-TE, K-13 probate) and checks text, versions, search and transcript; '@ suggests ... only them' by wall_mentions_and_links Part B, which excludes the complete non-viewer sets (M-12: Dev, Gwen; M-11: Paul) given only 3 seed matters; client scope checks the only foreign matter (M-12); transcript 'each message shows its author / its own sent time'; polish transcript_print 'every message's text'. 'Unchanged' guards accommodate legitimate side effects: wall_added_live 'Sian's page may briefly change; that is fine', unread leg 4 'at least 2', wall_every_route JUDGE-W3 accepts refusal or correct filing, edits leg 3 supplies the current version so only authorship explains refusal, and timer shortening on M-13 (timer_changes) does not delete K-8 'Draft will sent for your review.' (10 May, 2 days old) that later criteria rely on; the scripted golden run (golden-run.log, hash-verified, same source bytes) passes all criteria in order including persistence's exact-equality step. One instance fails the row: walls-and-retention.md last line makes a universal promise, 'When something you try is refused, the reason appears next to what you did and stays until you change it.', but the only criterion grading it, polish refusal_in_place (tests/scored/polish/judge.toml, criterion refusal_in_place), samples just the sign-in refusal, the one site where virtually every app already shows an inline error. No other criterion checks a reason for in-app refusals (stale edit in edits_and_stale_edit leg 2 checks only that the edit is refused and the text kept; held-delete in hold_scope_and_release leg 3 checks only that it stays). Lesser Note: 'Every message has a link' is only exercised on top-level messages (K-6, K-8, JUDGE-P2), never on a reply. No configured judge run on these bytes exists (raw-evidence-index scope), so judge interpretation is unmeasured.
counterexample: An app that shows 'Wrong password' inline under the sign-in form but reports every in-app refusal (stale edit, delete of a held message, a walled post) with a transient toast that vanishes after 3 s, or with no reason at all, scores full refusal_in_place credit while breaking the public promise for every refusal the brief actually describes in matters.
suggested_fix: Extend refusal_in_place (or edits_and_stale_edit leg 2) so it also checks one in-app refusal, e.g. the stale edit: a reason in words appears next to the edit box and is still there after about ten seconds; the golden already does this via composer-error/action-error (app.js:104, 366-376, 486).
